ndcbf5f61a1.headline: Another blow at the pumps in February
ndcbf5f61a1.summary: Petrol will rise by 53 cents a litre, diesel by 80 cents a litre and illuminating paraffin by R1.01 a litre from midnight on Tuesday, according to the report. The AA cited the February increase.
ndcbf5f61a1.why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport costs, inflation and consumer spending in South Africa. Adjustments are set by the regulator and track international oil and rand prices.

n5d6a2d232e.headline: Novozymes delivers strong 2021 full-year results and expects continued, solid progress in 2022
n5d6a2d232e.summary: Novozymes delivered 6% organic sales growth for 2021 and outlined an organic growth outlook of 3-7% for 2022. The Danish enzymes company says it is executing its strategic framework.
n5d6a2d232e.why: Novozymes is a Danish biotechnology company supplying industrial enzymes to sectors including food, agriculture and biofuels, and its guidance is a read on global industrial demand.

naf83cc6008.headline: Euro zone jobless rate falls to record low in Dec 2021
naf83cc6008.summary: Euro zone unemployment fell to its lowest level on record in December, data showed on Tuesday. The figure points to continued strength in the bloc's labour market.
naf83cc6008.why: The euro area unemployment rate is a key gauge of economic health that central bankers and investors watch when judging inflation pressure and the outlook for monetary policy.

n0c489cf4bf.headline: India Union Budget 2022 targets infrastructure spending
n0c489cf4bf.summary: The Indian government has projected growth of 8% to 8.5% in the Union Budget 2022, which targets infrastructure spending. The budget frames the fiscal plan for the coming year.
n0c489cf4bf.why: The Union Budget sets India's fiscal priorities, spending and growth assumptions, which shape the outlook for its large domestic economy and markets.

n0a2420126e.headline: One year after Ripples Nigeria report, Reps say 71m bank accounts without identities
n0a2420126e.summary: Lawmakers said about 71 million bank accounts in Nigeria lack identities, one year after a Ripples Nigeria report. The lawmakers cited the central bank's framework for regulating the banking industry.
n0a2420126e.why: Know-your-customer rules and identity verification in banking affect financial crime compliance and the risk profile of Nigerian lenders.

nb3c545fee8.headline: Activists demand stop to Japan-funded coal plant in climate-vulnerable Bangladesh | Headlines
nb3c545fee8.summary: Youth activists called on Japan to stop funding construction of a coal-fired power plant in Bangladesh, citing emissions and climate risks. JICA commented and Sumitomo responded.
nb3c545fee8.why: Sumitomo Corporation is a Japanese trading and industrial conglomerate, and export-credit and project financing decisions affect such companies' project pipelines.

n10fd27bb45.headline: UAE to impose federal corporate tax for the first time
n10fd27bb45.summary: The UAE will impose a federal corporate tax for the first time. The move marks a major change to the country's business tax regime.
n10fd27bb45.why: The UAE has long had low direct taxes, so a federal corporate tax changes the cost base for companies operating in the Gulf's main business hubs.

nba2403e45f.headline: Nayib Bukele fires back after the IMF said El Salvador should drop BTC
nba2403e45f.summary: Salvadoran leaders hit back after the IMF urged the country to stop using bitcoin as legal tender. The IMF said El Salvador should drop bitcoin.
nba2403e45f.why: El Salvador was the first country to adopt bitcoin as legal tender, and its IMF program makes its crypto policy a lending condition.

n83647e5cc8.headline: AmmPower announces Letter of Intent to develop ammonia production facility at the Port of South Louisiana
n83647e5cc8.summary: AmmPower announced a letter of intent to develop an ammonia production facility at the Port of South Louisiana. The plant could produce up to 4,000 tonnes of green ammonia per day, subject to feasibility studies.
n83647e5cc8.why: Ammonia is a major industrial chemical used in fertilisers, and green ammonia is a low-carbon alternative being developed for energy and shipping markets.

nbba02d0b44.headline: Searches are underway at the former head of Naftogaz Kobolev's premises
nbba02d0b44.summary: Ukraine's State Bureau of Investigation is conducting searches at the home and office of former Naftogaz head Andriy Kobolev and related companies.
nbba02d0b44.why: Naftogaz is Ukraine's state energy company; investigations may impact corporate governance and energy sector stability.

na133f5b346.headline: Path Investments Proposed Acquisition Of DG Innovate Ltd Update
na133f5b346.summary: Path Investments has proposed to acquire DG Innovate Ltd, according to an update.
na133f5b346.why: Mergers and acquisitions can reshape company strategies and market positions in technology sectors.

n96eb704deb.headline: Budget 2022: A Fiat Crypto Digital Rupee To Be Launched By RBI In 2022-23
n96eb704deb.summary: India's Reserve Bank plans to introduce a blockchain-based digital rupee to enhance currency efficiency and reduce costs.
n96eb704deb.why: Central bank digital currencies can impact monetary policy, payment systems, and currency stability.

n1f65225ca4.headline: Manufacturing output growth ramps up as supply chain crisis ‘passes its peak’
n1f65225ca4.summary: UK manufacturing output grew at its fastest pace since July 2021, indicating a recovery from supply chain disruptions.
n1f65225ca4.why: Manufacturing growth reflects economic resilience and can influence investor confidence and currency stability.

n96e66570b6.headline: Japanâ€™s top currency diplomat says weak yen has merits and demerits for economy
n96e66570b6.summary: Japan’s top currency diplomat states a weak yen has both merits and demerits for the economy, affecting export competitiveness and import costs.
n96e66570b6.why: Currency fluctuations influence trade balances, corporate profits, and inflation, impacting investor sentiment and monetary policy.

ncfa2cd6555.headline: Saudi Arabia announces $6.4 billion investments in future technologies
ncfa2cd6555.summary: Saudi Arabia announces $6.4 billion investments in future technologies, including $1 billion for start-ups and $1 billion for submarine cables and data centers.
ncfa2cd6555.why: These investments aim to diversify Saudi Arabia's economy and boost its technology and infrastructure sectors, impacting regional and global markets.

n2e38c96fe8.headline: Union Budget 2022: Indian Startup Founders & Investors Hail Crypto Tax
n2e38c96fe8.summary: India's Finance Minister announced a 30% tax on cryptocurrency income, signaling regulatory clarity and potential market impact.
n2e38c96fe8.why: Taxation on crypto assets affects investor behavior, market liquidity, and the development of the digital asset sector in India.

n5e1a42e692.headline: Andhra Pradesh: Debt takes 3 lives, weaver family commits suicide in Krishna district
n5e1a42e692.summary: Debt-related distress has resulted in fatalities among a weaving family, highlighting economic hardship in the region.
n5e1a42e692.why: Debt crises can impact local economies and social stability, affecting consumer spending and regional development.

nf7d0f8ea66.headline: Budget 2022: SEZ Act getting ready for a makeover
nf7d0f8ea66.summary: India's commerce ministry is working on a new Special Economic Zones Act to enhance growth and align with global trade norms.
nf7d0f8ea66.why: Reforms to SEZ policies can improve export competitiveness and attract foreign investment.

n88e7ea351d.headline: SHC stops FIA from taking action against Hareem Shah
n88e7ea351d.summary: The Sindh High Court stops FIA from proceeding with money laundering case against Hareem Shah.
n88e7ea351d.why: Legal proceedings involving public figures can influence regulatory environment and investor confidence.

nf3bb3f283a.headline: Exactly how much your shopping bill is going up as inflation hits 3.8%
nf3bb3f283a.summary: UK grocery price inflation increased again, reflecting ongoing inflationary pressures affecting household budgets.
nf3bb3f283a.why: Rising inflation impacts consumer spending, currency value, and monetary policy decisions.

n76072e29f7.headline: Pakistan’s textile exports to hit new heights as regional orders divert: report
n76072e29f7.summary: Pakistan's textile exports are expected to increase due to regional order diversion from India and Bangladesh.
n76072e29f7.why: Textile exports are vital for Pakistan's economy and trade balance, affecting employment and foreign revenue.

n7688890279.headline: 'Average day-ahead prices rose by 235% in 2021'
n7688890279.summary: Average day-ahead electricity prices increased significantly, reaching £118/MWh from £35/MWh.
n7688890279.why: Energy prices impact electricity costs for consumers and businesses, affecting inflation and energy markets.

n7b7279f7e5.headline: Commentary: Existing Virginia landfills and gas operations should face renewed scrutiny • Virginia Mercury
n7b7279f7e5.summary: Residents oppose Waste Management's landfill expansion in Charles City County, citing environmental and community impacts.
n7b7279f7e5.why: Local environmental policies can influence waste management and land use sectors.

n3b0748694e.headline: Manufacturing output growth ramps up as supply chain crisis ‘passes its peak’
n3b0748694e.summary: January manufacturing output grew at its fastest pace since July 2021, indicating a recovery from supply chain disruptions.
n3b0748694e.why: Manufacturing growth impacts industrial output, employment, and economic recovery prospects.

ndbbeb8c83f.headline: It’s the (French) economy, stupid. But whose economy?
ndbbeb8c83f.summary: France’s GDP is rising, but the country faces challenges in paying its bills despite economic growth.
ndbbeb8c83f.why: French economic health impacts eurozone stability, currency markets, and regional investment flows.

n75e27fc282.headline: Annual UK grocery bill could rise by £180 amid cost of living squeeze
n75e27fc282.summary: Prices in UK grocery stores increased by 3.8% over four weeks, according to Kantar, raising household expenses.
n75e27fc282.why: Rising food prices affect consumer inflation, purchasing power, and monetary policy considerations.

nb88bd9f721.headline: IPVA-SP: drivers can pay with a 5% discount starting today
nb88bd9f721.summary: Drivers in São Paulo state can pay the IPVA vehicle tax with a 5% discount starting today. Those who failed to pay in January lost the larger 9% discount.
nb88bd9f721.why: IPVA is the state vehicle property tax in Brazil, and changes to its payment terms affect state revenue and household costs.

n54bb9031ab.headline: Cryptocurrencies: FTX, created in 2019 by a 27-year-old American, is now worth 32 billion dollars
n54bb9031ab.summary: The cryptocurrency exchange FTX, founded in 2019, is now worth roughly the same as French bank Société Générale after a second fundraising round in less than a week.
n54bb9031ab.why: FTX is a cryptocurrency derivatives and spot trading platform, and its private valuation is a gauge of investor appetite for crypto firms.

nc0171fc040.headline: After the agreement with the IMF, another u$s 360 million is paid: will they return?
nc0171fc040.summary: The government will pay another $360 million to the IMF, following last Friday's payment. Together the payments total more than $1 billion amid scarce reserves and pending program approval.
nc0171fc040.why: The IMF is the international lender to Argentina, and repayments draw on the central bank's foreign reserves. Reserve levels matter for investors assessing the country's sovereign debt and currency.
